Hint.owners: Share % of each actor. What is not assigned goes to the holding fund (pays for buildings and hiring).
Hint.stats: Each point adds 'per point' income every period. Max 0 = unlimited.
Hint.units: Players hire (+) from the fund. Cap: number, stat or stat*factor (e.g. Vines*2); workers above it are paid but produce nothing. Prod./month: number or stat*factor (e.g. Tools*5) of the product in "Makes" (empty = first).
Hint.upgrades: Offered by the GM. Effects: Morale+5;Guards+2 (stat or unit names). Requires: condition to be able to buy it (e.g. Vines>=3), to build upgrade trees.
Hint.events: Amount / missed: formulas (gain or loss). Effects: Morale+5;Guards-2. Condition: Morale<30;Fund>100. Season: Fall,Summer. Weight: odds vs others. Deadline: periods to attend.
Hint.contracts: Deals won in play: buyer, product, quantity per month, agreed price and months (0 = forever). Filled before the market.
Hint.products: Reference: normal worth (GM sets it). Price: what owners charge (they change it on the sheet). Quality: number or stat (e.g. Quality), +20% worth per point. Demand: units per month the market buys at fair price (number or stat, e.g. Prestige*10); double the price sells a quarter, half price four times as much. Unsold goods stay in stock. Contracts are filled first. Spoilage: % of stock lost per month (perishables). Requires: condition to make and sell it (e.g. Cellar>=1).
Hint.staff: Named people hired apart from workers. Stars 1-5. Effects per star while employed (e.g. Quality+0.5 at 3★ = +1.5). Wage per period, one-time signing fee and training cost per star. The GM offers them (Offer) when they show up in play.

S.languageHint: Select language for Passive Income MGK (Auto follows Foundry language).
